top_signals.title: Citi Economist Sees Rates Restrictive for Real Economy
top_signals.summary: Veronica Clark, US economist at Citi Research, points to slowing economic activity outside of Artificial Intelligence and suggests that a modest increase in inflation could keep the Federal Reserve on hold in October and December. She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
